text: {"lessons":["I should avoid selling stocks solely because they have risen above my average cost; consider the overall portfolio and whether the investment still fits my needs.","Frequent partial sales can reduce exposure and lock in gains, but I should weigh that against missing further growth and avoid making trades without a clear reason.","My account has grown so far, but a few positive months do not guarantee future stability; prioritize diversification and limiting risk to help protect savings needed for living expenses."]}
